components.name: More posts
components.css: .ds-more { min-height:44px; padding:8px 16px; border:1px solid var(--news-rule); border-radius:3px; background:transparent; color:var(--news-ink); font:500 13px/1.5 var(--news-ui); cursor:pointer; }.ds-more:hover { border-color:var(--news-blue); color:var(--news-blue); }.ds-more:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--news-blue); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Search field
components.description: Inline full-text search within the current list.
components.html: <label class="ds-search">Search <input type="search" aria-label="Search all posts" placeholder="Search all posts…"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; min-height:58px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--news-rule); color:var(--news-muted); font:500 14px/1.5 var(--news-ui); }.ds-search input { min-height:44px; padding:8px 0; border:0; background:transparent; color:var(--news-ink); font:inherit; }.ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--news-blue); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Content filters
components.description: Plain text filters with an underlined selected state.
components.css: .ds-filters { display:flex; gap:24px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--news-rule); }.ds-filters button { min-height:44px; padding:0 0 10px; border:0; border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:var(--news-muted); font:500 13px/1.4 var(--news-ui); cursor:pointer; }.ds-filters button:hover,.ds-filters button[aria-pressed="true"] { color:var(--news-ink); }.ds-filters button[aria-pressed="true"] { border-bottom:2px solid var(--news-ink); }.ds-filters button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--news-blue); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Post row
components.description: A flat dated link row. Optional thumbnails occupy the first column.
components.html: A note about making softwareNov 6, 2026
components.css: .ds-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:40px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items:center; gap:14px; min-height:68px; padding:12px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--news-rule); color:var(--news-ink); text-decoration:none; }.ds-title { font:500 17px/1.4 var(--news-ui); }.ds-row time { color:var(--news-muted); font:500 11px/1.5 var(--news-ui); white-space:nowrap; }.ds-row:hover { color:var(--news-blue); }.ds-row:hover .ds-title { text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:4px; }.ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--news-blue); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Direct navigation
components.description: Direct links with an underlined active section; horizontal scrolling at narrow widths.
components.html: WritingSoftwareTech
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:22px; overflow-x:auto; }.ds-nav a { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; flex-shrink:0; min-height:44px; color:var(--news-muted); font:500 13px/1.4 var(--news-ui); text-decoration:none; }.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a[aria-current] { color:var(--news-ink); text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:6px; }.ds-nav a[aria-current] { text-decoration-color:var(--news-blue); text-decoration-thickness:2px; }.ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--news-blue); outline-offset: 5px; }

narrative.overview:
A quiet personal publication for software, cooking, photos, and life. The homepage and shared archives use plain dated rows, clear controls, and short supporting notes. Life has a route-specific Cefalù pixel coast and photo-led stories. These are fixed page designs, not optional modes. The newspaper edition, large masthead, layout switch, and benchmark insert are removed.

Keep the established publication palette and fonts. This change affects discovery pages; individual tech articles, recipes, life stories, notes, and link pages retain their reading layouts.
